'''Walter Gilman (Chapter 7)''' is a special [[ally]] used in [[Gilman and his King|scenario 7]] of the 1st Arkham Spanish League.

==Card info==
*+1 [[Focus]]
*+1 [[Lore]]

Each time a [[Weather]] card is discarded, the investigator that has Gilman as an ally loses 1 [[Stamina]].

==Notes==
This is one of multiple versions of the Walter Gilman ally used by different scenarios.
